source: IFS=:; set -- a b; v="$@"; echo "$v"

name: local-export
source: x=private; sh -c 'echo local:${x-unset}'; export x; sh -c 'echo exported:$x'; x=changed; sh -c 'echo reassigned:$x'

name: export-unset
source: export notset; echo ${notset+set}; sh -c 'echo child:${notset+set}'; notset=value; sh -c 'echo child:$notset'

name: prefix-export
source: x=old; x=new sh -c 'echo child:$x'; echo parent:$x; sh -c 'echo still:${x-unset}'

name: export-assignment
source: value='two words *'; export x=$value; sh -c 'echo "$x"'

name: export-subshell
source: x=parent; (export x; sh -c 'echo inner:$x'); sh -c 'echo outer:${x-unset}'

name: unset-export
source: export x=old; unset x; x=new; sh -c 'echo ${x-unset}'

name: unset-function
source: f() { echo yes; }; f; unset -f f; f; echo status:$?

name: function-inheritance
source: f() { echo parent; }; sh -c 'f'; echo child:$?; f

name: export-roundtrip
source: x="a'b"; export x; export -p > exp; unset x; . ./exp; echo "$x"

name: function-exports
source: x=local; f() { x=changed; export y=visible; sh -c 'echo ${x-unset}:$y'; }; f; echo $x:$y

name: function-prefix
source: x=old; f() { echo $x; x=inner; other=kept; export y=value; }; x=new f; echo $x:$other:$y; sh -c 'echo ${x-unset}:$y'

name: function-args
source: set -- parent; f() { printf "<%s>\n" "$@"; set -- changed; return 7; }; f "" "two words"; echo "$?:$1"

name: source-scope
source:
printf '%s
' 'x=sourced; export y=visible; f() { echo function; }; return 6; echo BAD' > scope; x=parent; . ./scope; echo "$?:$x"; f; sh -c 'echo "${x-unset}:$y"'

name: source-args
source:
printf '%s
' 'printf "<%s>
" "$@"; set -- changed; return 4' > scope; set -- parent; . ./scope; echo "$?:$1"

name: subshell-scope
source: export x=outer; f() { echo original; }; (x=inner; export y=yes; f() { echo changed; }; sh -c 'echo $x:$y'; f); echo $x:${y-unset}; f

name: printf-strings
source:
printf '[%8.3s][%-5s][%c]
' abcdef xy Z; printf '%s:%s
' one two three

name: printf-escapes
source: printf '\101\t%s\n' ok; printf '%b' 'a\tb\012c'; printf '%bAFTER' 'end\cignored'; echo done

name: printf-binary
source: printf 'A\000B'; printf '%b' 'C\0000D'; printf '%c' ''; printf '%5.3b' 'a\tbcd'

name: printf-missing
source:
printf '%s:%d:%c
'; printf -- '-%s-
' ok

name: printf-character-number
source:

' "'A" '"B'

name: printf-invalid

name: test-negation
source: test ! 2 -eq 3; echo $?; [ ! abc = def ]; echo $?; test ! ! ''; echo $?

name: test-groups
source: test '(' 2 -lt 3 ')'; echo $?; test ! '(' -z foo ')'; echo $?; [ '(' '' ')' ]; echo $?

name: test-operands
source: test ! = !; echo $?; [ -n = -n ]; echo $?; test '(' = ')'; echo $?; test !; echo $?

name: test-numbers

name: test-files
source: printf x > item; test -s item; echo $?; test -f item; echo $?; test -d .; echo $?; test -e missing; echo $?; [ -z "" ]; echo $?

name: at-fallback
source: set -- "a b" "" c; printf "<%s>\n" "${x:-$@}"; x=set; printf "<%s>\n" "${x:+$@}"

name: at-empty-fallback
source: set --; printf "<%s>\n" "${x:-$@}"
